stem.text: Synthetic resins can be made by polymerisation of a variety of monomers including prop-2-en-1-ol, $\text{CH}_2\text{=CHCH}_2\text{OH}$.
Which structure represents the repeat unit in the polymer poly(prop-2-en-1-ol)?

A.alt: Repeat unit of a polymer chain printed on one line: bracketed –CH2–CH2–CH2–O– unit

B.alt: Repeat unit in brackets: –CH2–CH– chain with CH2OH drawn below the second carbon

C.alt: Repeat unit in brackets: –CH=C– chain with CH2OH drawn below the second carbon

D.alt: Repeat unit in brackets: –CH2–CH2–CH– chain with OH drawn below the third carbon
